keywords.name: New Browser
keywords.shortDoc: Opens a new browser instance (chromium, firefox, or webkit).
keywords.doc: Opens a new browser instance. Supported browsers are chromium, firefox, and webkit. The browser process is shared across contexts. Use headless=false for headed mode during development.

keywords.name: New Context
keywords.shortDoc: Creates a new isolated browser context with its own cookies, localStorage, and cache.
keywords.doc: Creates a new isolated browser context. Each context has its own cookies, localStorage, and cache. Useful for multi-user scenarios or clean test isolation. Example viewport: {'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}.

keywords.name: New Page
keywords.shortDoc: Opens a new page (tab) in the current context and optionally navigates to a URL.
keywords.doc: Opens a new page (tab) in the current browser context. If a URL is provided, navigates to it immediately. The new page becomes the active page for subsequent keywords.

keywords.name: Go To
keywords.shortDoc: Navigates the current page to the given URL.
keywords.doc: Navigates the current page to the specified URL. Waits for the page to reach the load state before returning.

keywords.name: Go Back
keywords.shortDoc: Navigates the current page back in browser history.
keywords.doc: Navigates the current page back in browser history, equivalent to clicking the browser back button.

keywords.name: Reload
keywords.shortDoc: Reloads the current page.
keywords.doc: Reloads the current page. Waits for the page to reach the load state before returning.

keywords.name: Click
keywords.shortDoc: Clicks the element matching the selector. Auto-waits for the element to be actionable.
keywords.doc: Clicks the element matching the given selector. Browser Library automatically waits for the element to be visible, stable, enabled, and able to receive events before clicking.

keywords.name: Fill Text
keywords.shortDoc: Sets the value of an input field directly. Fast, fires the change event.
keywords.doc: Fills a text input with the given text by setting the value directly. This is fast and fires the change event. Use Type Text for keystroke simulation.

keywords.name: Type Text
keywords.shortDoc: Simulates real keystrokes into the input field with optional delay between keys.
keywords.doc: Types the given text into the element by simulating real keystrokes. Useful when the application relies on keydown/keypress/keyup events. The delay parameter controls time between keystrokes.

keywords.name: Fill Secret
keywords.shortDoc: Same as Fill Text but the value is NOT logged (for passwords).
keywords.doc: Fills a text input with the given secret value. Same as Fill Text but the value is masked in logs. Use for passwords and sensitive data.

keywords.name: Check Checkbox
keywords.shortDoc: Checks the checkbox matching the selector.
keywords.doc: Checks the checkbox matching the given selector. If the checkbox is already checked, this keyword does nothing.

keywords.name: Select Options By
keywords.shortDoc: Selects options from a select element by value, label, text, or index.
keywords.doc: Selects options in a <select> element. The attribute parameter specifies how to match: 'value', 'label', 'text', or 'index'.

keywords.name: Get Text
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the text content of the element. Supports inline assertions.
keywords.doc: Returns the text content of the element matching the selector. When assertion_operator and assertion_expected are provided, validates the text inline (e.g., Get Text h1 == Welcome).

keywords.name: Get Property
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the value of a DOM property (e.g., value, checked, href).
keywords.doc: Returns the value of a JavaScript DOM property of the element. Common properties include 'value', 'checked', 'href', 'textContent'.

keywords.name: Get Attribute
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the value of an HTML attribute of the element.
keywords.doc: Returns the value of the specified HTML attribute of the element matching the selector.

keywords.name: Get Element Count
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the number of elements matching the selector.
keywords.doc: Returns the count of elements matching the given selector. Supports assertion operators for inline validation.

keywords.name: Get Url
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the URL of the current page. Supports inline assertions.
keywords.doc: Returns the current page URL. Supports inline assertion operators (e.g., Get Url contains /dashboard).

keywords.name: Wait For Elements State
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the element reaches the specified state (visible, hidden, attached, etc.).
keywords.doc: Waits until an element reaches the desired state. States include: visible, hidden, attached, detached, enabled, disabled, stable, editable, readonly, selected, deselected, focused, defocused, checked, unchecked.

keywords.name: Wait For Response
keywords.shortDoc: Waits for a network response matching the URL pattern.
keywords.doc: Waits for a network response whose URL matches the given pattern. Useful for waiting on API calls after user interactions. Pattern supports glob matching (e.g., **/api/data).

keywords.name: Wait Until Network Is Idle
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until all network requests have completed.
keywords.doc: Waits until no network requests have been made for a period, indicating the page has finished loading data.

keywords.name: Take Screenshot
keywords.shortDoc: Takes a screenshot of the current viewport, a specific element, or the full page.
keywords.doc: Captures a screenshot. Without arguments, captures the current viewport. Use fullPage=true for a full-page screenshot, or provide a selector to capture a specific element.

keywords.name: Open Browser
keywords.shortDoc: Opens a browser to the given URL using the specified browser type.
keywords.doc: Opens a new browser instance and navigates to the given URL. Supported browsers: chrome, firefox, edge, headless_chrome, headless_firefox, headless_edge. Options can pass browser-specific arguments.

keywords.name: Close Browser
keywords.shortDoc: Closes the current browser.
keywords.doc: Closes the currently active browser instance and its WebDriver session.

keywords.name: Close All Browsers
keywords.shortDoc: Closes all open browsers and their WebDriver sessions.
keywords.doc: Closes all browser instances that were opened during the test. Typically used in suite teardown.

keywords.name: Maximize Browser Window
keywords.shortDoc: Maximizes the current browser window.
keywords.doc: Maximizes the current browser window to fill the screen.

keywords.name: Set Window Size
keywords.shortDoc: Sets the browser window to the specified width and height in pixels.
keywords.doc: Sets the inner size of the current browser window to the specified width and height in pixels.

keywords.name: Go To
keywords.shortDoc: Navigates the current browser to the given URL.
keywords.doc: Navigates the active browser to the specified URL.

keywords.name: Go Back
keywords.shortDoc: Navigates back in the browser history.
keywords.doc: Simulates clicking the browser's back button.

keywords.name: Reload Page
keywords.shortDoc: Reloads the current page.
keywords.doc: Reloads (refreshes) the current page.

keywords.name: Get Location
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the current browser URL.
keywords.doc: Returns the URL of the currently active page.

keywords.name: Get Title
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the title of the current page.
keywords.doc: Returns the title element text of the currently active page.

keywords.name: Click Element
keywords.shortDoc: Clicks the element identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Clicks the element identified by locator. Supports id, name, xpath, css, class, tag, link, and data locator strategies.

keywords.name: Click Button
keywords.shortDoc: Clicks a button element identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Clicks a button element. The locator can match id, name, or value attributes of button and input[type=submit/reset/button] elements.

keywords.name: Input Text
keywords.shortDoc: Types the given text into the text field identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Types the given text into the element identified by locator. Does NOT clear the element first; use Clear Element Text first if needed.

keywords.name: Input Password
keywords.shortDoc: Types a password into the field. The value is not logged.
keywords.doc: Types the given password into the element identified by locator. The password value is masked in the log output for security.

keywords.name: Press Keys
keywords.shortDoc: Simulates pressing the given keys. Use None as locator for page-level keys.
keywords.doc: Presses the given key or key combination. Set locator to None for page-level key presses. Supports special keys like RETURN, TAB, CTRL+a, etc.

keywords.name: Wait Until Element Is Visible
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the element identified by locator is visible.
keywords.doc: Waits until the element specified by locator becomes visible on the page. Fails if the timeout expires before the element is visible.

keywords.name: Wait Until Element Is Not Visible
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the element identified by locator is no longer visible.
keywords.doc: Waits until the element specified by locator is no longer visible. Useful for waiting for spinners or loading indicators to disappear.

keywords.name: Wait Until Page Contains
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the page contains the specified text.
keywords.doc: Waits until the current page contains the given text somewhere in the DOM.

keywords.name: Wait Until Page Contains Element
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the page contains the element matching the locator.
keywords.doc: Waits until an element matching the given locator appears in the page DOM.

keywords.name: Element Should Be Visible
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the element identified by locator is visible.
keywords.doc: Verifies that the element matching the locator is visible on the page. Fails immediately if not visible.

keywords.name: Page Should Contain
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the current page contains the specified text.
keywords.doc: Verifies that the current page contains the given text somewhere in the page body.

keywords.name: Element Should Contain
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the element contains the expected text.
keywords.doc: Verifies that the element identified by locator contains the expected text as a substring.

keywords.name: Capture Page Screenshot
keywords.shortDoc: Takes a screenshot of the current page and saves it to a file.
keywords.doc: Takes a screenshot of the current browser page. If filename is not given, a unique name is generated. The screenshot is also embedded in the log file.

keywords.name: Capture Element Screenshot
keywords.shortDoc: Takes a screenshot of the element identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Captures a screenshot of a specific element on the page, cropped to the element's bounding box.

keywords.name: Open Application
keywords.shortDoc: Opens a mobile application on a device or emulator via Appium server.
keywords.doc: Opens a new application session. Requires the Appium server URL and desired capabilities. Key capabilities: platformName (Android/iOS), deviceName, automationName (UiAutomator2/XCUITest), app (path to APK/IPA).

keywords.name: Close Application
keywords.shortDoc: Closes the current application and ends the Appium session.
keywords.doc: Closes the current application and ends the Appium session. The WebDriver session is terminated.

keywords.name: Background Application
keywords.shortDoc: Puts the application in the background for the specified duration.
keywords.doc: Puts the current application into the background for the given number of seconds, then brings it back to the foreground.

keywords.name: Click Element
keywords.shortDoc: Clicks the mobile element identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Clicks the element identified by the locator. Supports accessibility_id, id, xpath, class, android=, ios=, chain= strategies.

keywords.name: Click Text
keywords.shortDoc: Clicks the element with the given visible text.
keywords.doc: Clicks an element whose visible text matches the given text string.

keywords.name: Input Text
keywords.shortDoc: Types text into the mobile input field identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Types the given text into the mobile input element identified by locator.

keywords.name: Clear Text
keywords.shortDoc: Clears the text from the input field identified by the locator.
keywords.doc: Clears the text content of the input element identified by the locator.

keywords.name: Tap
keywords.shortDoc: Taps the element. Use duration for long press (replaces removed Long Press keyword).
keywords.doc: Taps on the element identified by locator. When duration is provided (e.g., 0:00:01), performs a long press. This replaces the removed Long Press keyword in AppiumLibrary v3.2.0+.

keywords.name: Get Text
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the text content of the element.
keywords.doc: Returns the visible text of the element identified by the locator.

keywords.name: Get Element Attribute
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the value of the specified attribute of the element.
keywords.doc: Returns the value of the given attribute for the element matching the locator.

keywords.name: Get Source
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the XML source of the current page (view hierarchy).
keywords.doc: Returns the page source as XML, representing the current view hierarchy. Useful for debugging and finding locators.

keywords.name: Wait Until Element Is Visible
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the mobile element identified by locator is visible.
keywords.doc: Waits until the element specified by locator becomes visible on the screen.

keywords.name: Wait Until Page Contains
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the page contains the specified text.
keywords.doc: Waits until the current page contains the given text string.

keywords.name: Wait Until Page Contains Element
keywords.shortDoc: Waits until the page contains the element matching the locator.
keywords.doc: Waits until the element matching the given locator is present in the page source.

keywords.name: Swipe
keywords.shortDoc: Swipes from one point to another on the screen.
keywords.doc: Performs a swipe gesture from (start_x, start_y) to (end_x, end_y). Duration controls the swipe speed as a timedelta string (e.g., 0:00:01 for 1 second).

keywords.name: Scroll Down
keywords.shortDoc: Scrolls down within or to the element matching the locator.
keywords.doc: Scrolls the screen downward. The locator identifies the element to scroll within or to.

keywords.name: Scroll Up
keywords.shortDoc: Scrolls up within or to the element matching the locator.
keywords.doc: Scrolls the screen upward. The locator identifies the element to scroll within or to.

keywords.name: Tap With Positions
keywords.shortDoc: Taps at the specified screen coordinates.
keywords.doc: Performs a tap at the given (x, y) screen coordinates.

keywords.name: Switch To Context
keywords.shortDoc: Switches to the specified context (NATIVE_APP or WEBVIEW_*).
keywords.doc: Switches the automation context. Use 'NATIVE_APP' for native views or 'WEBVIEW_<package>' for hybrid app webviews.

keywords.name: Get Current Context
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the name of the current context.
keywords.doc: Returns the current context name (e.g., 'NATIVE_APP' or 'WEBVIEW_com.example.app').

keywords.name: Get Contexts
keywords.shortDoc: Returns a list of all available contexts.
keywords.doc: Returns a list of all available contexts for the current session, including NATIVE_APP and any WEBVIEW contexts.

keywords.name: GET
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a GET request to the URL and returns the response.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP GET request. Sessionless style: pass the full URL directly. Returns a response object with status_code, text, json(), headers, and cookies properties.

keywords.name: POST
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a POST request with optional JSON body or form data.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP POST request. Use 'json' parameter for JSON payloads or 'data' for form-encoded data. Returns a response object.

keywords.name: PUT
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a PUT request to replace a resource.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP PUT request to fully replace a resource at the given URL.

keywords.name: PATCH
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a PATCH request for partial resource update.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP PATCH request for partial update of a resource.

keywords.name: DELETE
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a DELETE request to remove a resource.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to remove the resource at the given URL.

keywords.name: HEAD
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a HEAD request to retrieve headers only.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP HEAD request. Returns only the response headers, no body content.

keywords.name: OPTIONS
keywords.shortDoc: Sends an OPTIONS request to get the allowed HTTP methods.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP OPTIONS request. Returns the allowed methods and other CORS-related headers.

keywords.name: Create Session
keywords.shortDoc: Creates a named session for making multiple requests to the same base URL.
keywords.doc: Creates a reusable HTTP session with the given alias and base URL. WARNING: verify defaults to False (SSL verification off). Always set verify=${True} for production.

keywords.name: GET On Session
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a GET request using an existing session.
keywords.doc: Performs a GET request using a previously created session. The URL is relative to the session base URL.

keywords.name: POST On Session
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a POST request using an existing session.
keywords.doc: Performs a POST request using a previously created session. The URL is relative to the session base URL.

keywords.name: DELETE On Session
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a DELETE request using an existing session.
keywords.doc: Performs a DELETE request using a previously created session.

keywords.name: Status Should Be
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the response status code matches the expected value.
keywords.doc: Asserts that the response object's status code equals the expected status code.

keywords.name: Request Should Be Successful
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the response status code is in the 2xx range.
keywords.doc: Asserts that the response status code is between 200 and 299 (inclusive), indicating a successful request.

keywords.name: GET
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a GET request to the endpoint (relative to base URL).
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP GET request to the given endpoint. The endpoint is relative to the base URL set in the Library import.

keywords.name: POST
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a POST request with a JSON body string.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP POST request. The body is a JSON string that is sent as the request payload.

keywords.name: PUT
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a PUT request to replace a resource.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP PUT request with the given JSON body.

keywords.name: PATCH
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a PATCH request for partial update.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with the given JSON body for partial resource update.

keywords.name: DELETE
keywords.shortDoc: Sends a DELETE request to remove a resource.
keywords.doc: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the given endpoint.

keywords.name: Integer
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is an integer, optionally matching a specific value.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is an integer. If value is provided, also asserts equality. Example: Integer response status 200.

keywords.name: String
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is a string, optionally matching a specific value.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is a string. Supports exact match, wildcard (*), and regex (/pattern/) matching.

keywords.name: Boolean
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is a boolean, optionally matching a specific value.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is a boolean.

keywords.name: Number
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is a number (float), optionally matching a value.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is a number (float/decimal).

keywords.name: Array
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is an array (JSON list).
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is an array.

keywords.name: Object
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is a JSON object. Optionally validates against a JSON Schema.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is a JSON object. When a schema is provided, validates the object against the JSON Schema.

keywords.name: Null
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field is null.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is null.

keywords.name: Missing
keywords.shortDoc: Validates that the field does not exist in the response.
keywords.doc: Validates that the given JSON path field is absent from the response.

keywords.name: Output
keywords.shortDoc: Logs the value of the field. Asserts the field exists.
keywords.doc: Logs the value at the given JSON path. The field must exist or the keyword fails.

keywords.name: Set Headers
keywords.shortDoc: Sets default headers for subsequent requests (JSON string).
keywords.doc: Sets headers as a JSON string that will be applied to all subsequent requests. Example: Set Headers {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.

keywords.name: Expect Response Body
keywords.shortDoc: Sets a JSON Schema file to validate the next response body against.
keywords.doc: Sets an expectation that the next response body must validate against the given JSON Schema file. Set BEFORE the HTTP request.

keywords.name: Clear Expectations
keywords.shortDoc: Removes all previously set schema expectations.
keywords.doc: Clears any previously set Expect Response Body or Expect Response expectations.

keywords.name: Set SSL Verify
keywords.shortDoc: Enables or disables SSL certificate verification.
keywords.doc: Controls whether SSL certificates are verified for subsequent requests. Set to ${False} to disable verification (not recommended for production).

keywords.name: Set Client Authentication
keywords.shortDoc: Sets HTTP Basic Authentication credentials for subsequent requests.
keywords.doc: Sets the username and password for HTTP Basic Authentication on all subsequent requests.

keywords.name: Set Variable
keywords.shortDoc: Sets and returns the given value. Used to assign variables inline.
keywords.doc: Returns the given value. Typically used as: ${var}= Set Variable value.

keywords.name: Create Dictionary
keywords.shortDoc: Creates and returns a dictionary from the given key=value pairs.
keywords.doc: Creates a Python dictionary from the given keyword arguments. Example: &{dict}= Create Dictionary key1=value1 key2=value2.

keywords.name: Create List
keywords.shortDoc: Creates and returns a list from the given items.
keywords.doc: Creates a Python list containing the given items. Example: @{list}= Create List item1 item2 item3.

keywords.name: Set Suite Variable
keywords.shortDoc: Sets a variable available in the current suite and all its children.
keywords.doc: Makes the variable available in the current test suite scope, including all tests and keywords within it.

keywords.name: Set Test Variable
keywords.shortDoc: Sets a variable available for the remainder of the current test.
keywords.doc: Makes the variable available for the remainder of the current test case.

keywords.name: Should Be Equal
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that two values are equal.
keywords.doc: Fails if the given objects are not equal. Both arguments are converted to strings for comparison by default.

keywords.name: Should Be Equal As Integers
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that two values are equal when converted to integers.
keywords.doc: Converts both arguments to integers and fails if they are not equal.

keywords.name: Should Contain
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the container contains the item (string, list, or dict).
keywords.doc: Fails if the container does not contain the given item. Works with strings (substring), lists (member), and dictionaries (key).

keywords.name: Should Not Be Empty
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the given item is not empty.
keywords.doc: Fails if the given item (string, list, or dict) is empty.

keywords.name: Length Should Be
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the length of the item matches the expected value.
keywords.doc: Fails if the length of the given item does not equal the expected length.

keywords.name: Run Keyword If
keywords.shortDoc: Runs the given keyword if the condition is true.
keywords.doc: Evaluates the given condition and runs the specified keyword if it is true. Consider using IF/ELSE syntax in RF 5+ instead.

keywords.name: Run Keyword If Test Failed
keywords.shortDoc: Runs the keyword only if the test has failed. Use in teardown.
keywords.doc: Runs the given keyword if the current test case has failed. Typically used in test teardown (e.g., to take screenshots on failure).

keywords.name: Sleep
keywords.shortDoc: Pauses execution for the given time.
keywords.doc: Pauses the test execution for the given time. Time can be given as a number (seconds) or a time string (e.g., 1m 30s, 500ms). Avoid using Sleep in favor of proper waiting keywords.

keywords.name: Log
keywords.shortDoc: Logs the given message at the specified log level.
keywords.doc: Logs the given message with the specified level (TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR). Default is INFO.

keywords.name: RETURN
keywords.shortDoc: Returns the given values from a user keyword.
keywords.doc: Returns the given values from the current user keyword. Replaces the old [Return] setting in RF 5+.

keywords.name: Dictionary Should Contain Key
keywords.shortDoc: Verifies that the dictionary contains the given key.
keywords.doc: Fails if the dictionary does not contain the specified key. Note: This is from the Collections library, commonly used alongside BuiltIn.
